title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
reason: 正文披露了 Gemini 4 Argon 这一面向机器人物理推理的模型及其在机器人控制、世界模型、仿真数字孪生上的新技术能力。
quote: Gemini 4 Argon marks a step change in physical understanding, code generation, and visual-semantic reasoning—unlocking new workflows across the robotics stack

title: robo_jepa
reason: RoboJEPA 是 Meta FAIR 发布的机器人潜在世界模型，包含预训练模型、代码与规划算法，属于机器人「大脑」范畴。
quote: PyTorch code and pretrained models for RoboJEPA: action-conditioned world models trained in the latent space of a frozen V-JEPA encoder, on robot data from 12 embodiments, at sizes from 22M to 8B parameters.

title: imprint
reason: IMPRINT 是面向 VLA 策略的长时程记忆模块，属于机器人「大脑」的策略学习与控制算法，并发布了模型、数据与仿真评测基础设施。
quote: IMPRINT is a policy-agnostic long-horizon memory module for vision-language-action policies.

title: lerobot/FineART
reason: FineART 是面向机器人双臂操作的数据集，含密集子任务标注，并配套发布 FineART-VLA 策略模型，属于机器人数据与 VLA 技术工作。
quote: FineART is a bimanual manipulation dataset where every episode comes with dense, human-written subtask annotations.
